facts.material: mixed: plastic/rubber goggles and snorkel, textile mesh bag, molded plastic capsule
facts.form: retail set of goggles, snorkel set, mesh bag and plastic capsule

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9506 covers other water-sport equipment; ch. 95 note 1(r) sends sports goggles to 9004, note 1(d) sends sports bags to 4202, so the set is not classifiable by one heading alone
GRI 3(b): put up as a retail set of different headings; essential character given by the snorkel/swim gear (water-sport equipment) over the incidental bag and capsule

rejected_alternatives.reason: goggles alone; they are one component and not the essential character of the set
bag is a minor component of the set
plastic capsule is a minor component

missing_facts: relative value/weight of each component to confirm the essential character
classification.rationale: Retail set of goods of different headings; under GRI 3(b) the snorkel and swim gear is the water-sport equipment that gives the set its character, consistent with L81175 which classified a children's swim combo (mask, snorkel, fins in carrying case) in 9506.29.0080.
